text: At its meeting on May 3, 2018, the Finance, Audit and Risk Management Committee considered a report (April 13, 2018) from the Vice President of Finance and Administration, Civic Theatres Toronto on 2019 Budget.

The Board of Directors of Civic Theatres Toronto: 1. Approved the Revised 2019 Budget Commentary and Presentation, as noted in Confidential Attachments 1 and 2 to the report (April 13, 2018) from the Vice President of Finance and Administration, Civic Theatres Toronto. 2. Directed the President and Chief Executive Officer, Civic Theatres Toronto to report back to the Board only if there are significant changes to the Budget prior to submission to the City's 2019 Budget Process. 3. Directed that Confidential Attachments 1 and 2 to the report (April 13, 2018) from the Vice President of Finance and Administration, Civic Theatres Toronto remain confidential as they pertain to the security of the property of the municipality or local board.
